searchText: at the time of the merge, the apis and error codes in particular were not well defined and differed wildly between implementations - ditto behavior on parallel in-flight requests, already-know blocks etc - I haven't checked lately but a classic example was what should happen if you fcu to the "previous" block - rewind the chain? stay with the current head? etc. afair there are still error codes in there which I believe are redundant and/or not implemented the same everywhere, though again, I haven't followed up on this lately this is also why the tool above is so simple - it seeks to not stress any unusual code paths - that said, even `eth_blockNumber` that it relies on isn't defined for the engine api, and in json-rpc it isn't defined with sufficient precision - "latest block number" can be just about anything - ie if the el is processing some blcok (syncing for example), we want it to return the point to which the el is synced but that is not guaranteed in nimbus, we can control this and give `eth_blockNumber` a sufficiently compatible implementation but that doesn't guaranteee the tool works for all el:s
